title: Rubin Observatory Finds Two New Neptune Trojans
paragraphs: Neptune is a planet far from the Sun. Some small rocks travel with it. They are called Trojans.
Scientists looked at new pictures. The pictures came from a big telescope in Chile. It is called the Rubin Observatory.
The team found two new Trojans. They also found one more that may be a Trojan. Before, scientists knew only two of this kind. Now they know four.

questions.q: How many new Trojans did the team find?
Is Neptune close to the Sun?
questions.a: No, it is far from the Sun.
